upscale_mode.description: Runs a pre-processing step to minimise noise and visual artifacts that may otherwise be amplified during enlargement.

roi.description: Region of interest to search for the subject, given as two x/y coordinate pairs in pixels ('0px 0px 100px 100px') or percentages ('0% 0% 100% 100%'). Anything outside this rectangle is treated as background.

crop.description: Crops the output image to the bounding box of the subject.

size.description: Maximum output image resolution. 'preview' caps at 0.25 megapixels, 'full' and 'auto' cap at 25 megapixels, and '50MP' allows up to 50 megapixels. PNG output is capped at 10 megapixels regardless of this setting.

type.description: Foreground type hint to improve cutout quality.

scale.description: Scale of the subject relative to the output canvas, as 'original' or a percentage between '10%' and '100%'.

format.description: Output image format. PNG and WebP preserve transparency, JPG does not. PNG is capped at 10 megapixels by the provider, so pair larger 'size' values with WebP to keep transparency. remove.bg's 'auto' is deliberately not offered: it picks PNG or JPG from the finished pixels, and the output's storage key has to be named before the request is sent.

bg_color.description: Adds a solid background color to the cutout (hex code or color name). Output is no longer transparent — pair with 'jpg' when possible.

channels.description: 'rgba' returns the cutout image; 'alpha' returns only the greyscale alpha mask.

position.description: Position of the subject within the output canvas, as 'original', 'center', a single percentage, or two percentages for horizontal and vertical placement.

type_level.description: How specifically the subject should be classified. 'none' skips classification, '1' picks a coarse category, '2' picks a specific category, and 'latest' uses the most detailed classification available.

crop_margin.description: Margin to add around the cropped subject, as an absolute value ('30px') or relative to the subject size ('10%'). Accepts one, two, or four values and only applies when 'crop' is enabled.

shadow_type.description: Style of artificial shadow to render under the subject.

shadow_opacity.description: Opacity of the artificial shadow, from 0 to 100. Only applies when a shadow is enabled.

semitransparency.description: Preserves semi-transparent regions such as glass, smoke, and veils.
